basic_details.job_title: DCPW Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 61 Assistant, Assistant Communication Officer Posts

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.dcpw.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DCPW Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: DCPW Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 61 vacancies are available - 9 for Assistant Communication Officer (Cy), 48 for Assistant Communication Officer, and 4 for Assistant.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.dcpw.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPW Assistant Communication Officer posts is 10-11-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Communication Officer posts?
faq.answer: A total of 61 vacancies are available for the Assistant Communication Officer and related posts in the Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless (DCPW) recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Communication Officer posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Communication Officer posts will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 35400 to Rs. 112400 per month, corresponding to Level 6 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the DCPW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website of DCPW?
faq.answer: The official website of the Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless (DCPW) is www.dcpw.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation. This means that the positions are filled by transferring employees from other government departments.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CBC 19129/11/0002/2627. This number should be used for reference when applying or inquiring about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the DCPW located?
faq.answer: The Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless (DCPW) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110003.

faq.question: Q10. Are there different types of Assistant Communication Officer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment includes different types of Assistant Communication Officer posts, such as Assistant Communication Officer (Cy) and Assistant Communication Officer, along with a few Assistant posts.
